display.purpose: Countdown numeral only, stroked over the photo (Lilita gold/navy; Anton yellow/ink in Forsiden).

headline.purpose: Result and gallery titles, shutter label, card-back title.

body.purpose: Default running text, errors and toasts.

label.purpose: Pill and chip labels; tabular numerals for counts.

forside-display.purpose: Anton, uppercase: replaces Lilita for headings, shutter, countdown and result line in Forsiden; sizes follow the shared roles.

masthead.purpose: Canvas, 1050 grid: magazine name, fit to the band left of the starburst, max 214px.

cover-headline.purpose: Canvas: surprise headline, max 112px, up to 3 lines, bottom-aligned, 12px ink outline.

cover-line.purpose: Canvas: teaser (max 50px, 9px outline); starburst text max 52px; strip and price 30px.

shadows.name: picture-lift
shadows.purpose: Live card or cover and finished face; card back and start tiles at 0.45.

shadows.name: shutter
shadows.purpose: Capture pill at rest: cream ring plus deep drop.

shadows.name: shutter-forside
shadows.purpose: Forsiden capture pill: white ring plus deep blue drop.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every button, chip and pocket presses in on :active.

motion.name: reveal-flip
motion.purpose: Card flips in from its back after capture; Forsiden reuses the duration and curve for cover-land.

motion.name: cover-land
motion.value: 1.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1.25, 0.4, 1); from translateY(-30%) rotate(-7deg) scale(1.08), opacity 0 to 1 by 45%
motion.purpose: Forsiden reveal: the cover drops onto the table instead of flipping.

motion.name: tilt-settle
motion.purpose: Card tilt returning to rest; 0.08s linear while touching. Also the result panel rise-in (0.6s, 0.8s delay).

motion.name: sheen-sweep
motion.purpose: Specular band across the live card stock; in Forsiden a white gloss band masked to the masthead (top 16.6%).

motion.name: foil-drift
motion.purpose: Foil drift on the card back.

components.name: Shutter
components.description: The one capture action: magenta pill with cream ring, the largest control on screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-shutter" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 6h1.8l1.4-2h4.6l1.4 2h1.8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 20 8.5v8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 17.5 19h-11A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 16.5v-8Z M12 15.5a3.2 3.2 0 1 0 0-6.4 3.2 3.2 0 0 0 0 6.4Z"/></svg>Tag kort!</button>
components.css: .ds-shutter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-width: 340px; height: 108px; padding: 0 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--magenta, #ff4fd8); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); font-family: 'Lilita One', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--cream, #fff7e0), 0 16px 36px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.42); transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-shutter svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; } .ds-shutter:active { transform: translateY(3px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--cream, #fff7e0), 0 6px 16px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-shutter:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Forsiden Shutter
components.description: Forsiden capture pill: masthead red, white Anton caps, white ring.
components.html: <button class="ds-shutter-fs" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 6h1.8l1.4-2h4.6l1.4 2h1.8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 20 8.5v8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 17.5 19h-11A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 16.5v-8Z M12 15.5a3.2 3.2 0 1 0 0-6.4 3.2 3.2 0 0 0 0 6.4Z"/></svg>Tag forsiden!</button>
components.css: .ds-shutter-fs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-width: 340px; height: 108px; padding: 0 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ff2a3d; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #ffffff, 0 16px 36px 4px rgb(0 30 70 / 0.4); transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-shutter-fs svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; } .ds-shutter-fs:active { transform: translateY(3px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #ffffff, 0 6px 16px 2px rgb(0 30 70 / 0.4); } .ds-shutter-fs:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Primary non-capture action (Print, Del): gold with navy label and icon.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-pill svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-pill:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Quiet Pill with Count
components.description: Navigation and secondary actions; the booth's Samling button carries a gold count badge.
components.css: .ds-pill-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); } .ds-pill-quiet svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill-quiet:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-count { min-width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); display: grid; place-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Danger Pill
components.description: Two-tap delete: coral tint at rest, solid coral once armed.
components.css: .ds-pill-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: rgb(255 107 90 / 0.16); color: #ffb3aa; } .ds-pill-danger svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill-danger.armed { background: var(--danger, #ff6b5a); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-pill-danger:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-danger:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Card-type picker: pill with a type-gradient disc and filled element glyph; gold when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px; padding: 16px; background: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-chip { height: 84px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 42px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); animation: ds-pick 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.6, 0.5, 1); } .ds-chip-disc { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--c1), var(--c2)); } .ds-chip-disc svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; } @keyframes ds-pick { 0% { transform: scale(0.9); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Effect Chip
components.description: Effect picker: translucent disc with a stroked icon; chosen state is gold with a navy disc and gold icon.
components.css: .ds-chips-fx { padding: 16px; background: var(--navy, #141a4d); max-width: 420px; } .ds-chip-fx { width: 100%; height: 84px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 42px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip-fx:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip-fx:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip-fx[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-fx-disc { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-chip-fx[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-fx-disc { background: var(--navy, #141a4d); color: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); } .ds-fx-disc svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; }

components.css: .ds-chips-mag { display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px; padding: 16px; background: #0a8fd0; } .ds-chip-mag { height: 84px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 42px; background: rgb(0 40 80 / 0.22); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip-mag:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip-mag:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip-mag[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ffe600; color: #111111; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-mag-disc { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; } .ds-mag-disc svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; }

components.name: Card Back
components.description: The start card and flip back: navy pinwheel, double gold border, tilted gold title, drifting foil.
components.css: .ds-card-back { position: relative; height: 420px; aspect-ratio: 5 / 7; border: 0; border-radius: 5.2% / 3.7%; color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 0 34%, rgb(255 207 31 / 0.14) 34.4% 35%, transparent 35.4%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, var(--navy-3, #2f3a94) 0 10deg, var(--navy-2, #232c78) 10deg 20deg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 14px var(--gold, #ffcf1f), inset 0 0 0 18px var(--gold-deep, #e0a800), 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; gap: 0.6em; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-card-back::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(115deg, #4ef0ff 0%, #ff4fd8 30%, #ffe14d 55%, #4ef0ff 80%, #ff4fd8 100%); background-size: 300% 300%; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; opacity: 0.22; animation: ds-drift 9s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-back:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-card-back:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cb-title { font-family: 'Lilita One', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; color: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); text-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transform: rotate(-6deg); } .ds-cb-sub { font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; } @keyframes ds-drift { to { background-position: 300% 300%; } }

components.name: Theme Pick
components.description: Start-screen door into a world: the world's own picture over a name pill in its voice; last-used gets a cream ring.
components.css: .ds-picks { display: flex; gap: 48px; justify-content: center; padding: 32px; background: #141a4d; } .ds-pick { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 16px; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-pick:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pick:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-pick-art { display: block; height: 280px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); overflow: hidden; } .ds-pick.last .ds-pick-art { outline: 5px solid #fff7e0; outline-offset: 8px; } .ds-pick-card { aspect-ratio: 5 / 7; border-radius: 5.2% / 3.7%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #2f3a94 0 10deg, #232c78 10deg 20deg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 10px #ffcf1f, inset 0 0 0 13px #e0a800, 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-pick-cover { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; border-radius: 0.6%; background: linear-gradient(#8fd3f7, #f3e3cf); } .ds-mast { display: block; height: 16.6%; background: #ff2a3d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-size: 34px; line-height: 46px; padding-left: 8px; } .ds-strip { display: block; background: #111; color: #fff; font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; } .ds-pick-name { font-size: 34px; padding: 6px 28px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-kort { background: #ffcf1f; color: #141a4d; font-family: 'Lilita One', sans-serif; } .ds-fs { background: #ff2a3d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.northStar: The Collector's Binder (Samlekort) / This Week's Cover (Forsiden)
narrative.overview:
Fotoboksen has two worlds on one skeleton. A start screen offers both; the choice sets `data-theme` (kort or forside) on the body, and the booth, result, gallery and viewer keep the same structure, controls and motion grammar while ground, accent, display face and picture object change. Every saved picture remembers its own theme, so the gallery holds cards and covers side by side, each drawn in its own world; pictures from before themes existed are cards. The last-picked theme is remembered and ringed on the start screen; "Skift tema" in the gallery returns there.

**Samlekort.** Every photo is minted as a holo trading card, and the whole app is the binder the card lives in. The ground is deep binder navy; the objects on it are gold card stock, holo foil and cream plates. The live camera is not a viewfinder but the art window of an upright 5:7 card. Everything on the card (gold stock, type-coloured panel, cream mat, navy ribbon, cream stats plate) is drawn on canvas on a fixed 1000 x 1400 grid, so preview, JPEG and print are the same object. Motion belongs to the card: a foil sweep on the live card, a 3D flip reveal, tilt and a finger-tracked foil highlight on the finished card.

**Forsiden.** Every photo is this week's magazine cover. The ground is saturated newsstand cyan; the photo runs full bleed on a 3:4 cover under a solid masthead band in the chosen magazine's colour, a black issue strip, and white Anton cover lines with a heavy black outline. A yellow starburst sticker and a barcode box finish the newsstand. The whole overlay is drawn on a 1050 x 1400 canvas grid over the photo, by the same code for the live preview, the saved JPEG and the start-screen tile. Motion: a gloss that sweeps the masthead only, and a reveal where the cover drops onto the table instead of flipping.

Shared by both: low density and huge controls, two columns of fat chips flanking the picture, one big shutter pill under it, every control word backed by an authored icon; chrome only answers touches with a press-scale and a springy pick.
keyCharacteristics: One skeleton, two worlds, switched by `data-theme` on the body and on each saved picture.
The picture (5:7 card or 3:4 cover) is the largest object on every screen except the gallery grid.
Samlekort: navy ground, gold and cream objects, magenta reserved for the capture pill; Lilita One display.
Forsiden: cyan ground, yellow for chosen, red reserved for the capture pill, ink outlines; Anton display in caps.
Pills and discs everywhere in the chrome in both worlds; the picture carries the world's corner.

rules.name: The One Shutter Colour Rule
rules.body: Each world has exactly one solid capture colour: magenta in Samlekort, red in Forsiden. It fills only the capture pill (and, in Forsiden, its name pill on the start screen). Everything else that is chosen or primary is gold (Samlekort) or yellow with ink (Forsiden).

rules.name: The Declared Ink Rule
rules.body: Every frame option declares the ink that reads on its colour. Lyn is the only light card type: its ink, glyph and footer flip to navy. Magazine bands declare bandInk (white, ink or yellow). Any new type or magazine with a light colour must declare a dark ink the same way.

rules.name: The Caps Belong To The World Rule
rules.body: In Samlekort, uppercase appears only inside the drawn card (ribbon, stat label, set mark) as trading-card printing, and app chrome is sentence case. In Forsiden, caps are the magazine's voice: Anton display (picker, result and gallery headings, shutter, countdown hint, theme name) and every cover line are uppercase. In both worlds Baloo labels on chips and pills stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Stroke-Under Rule
rules.body: Display text laid over the photo carries a dark stroke painted under the fill (CSS paint-order: stroke fill; canvas strokeText before fillText) so it reads over any face: navy in Samlekort, ink in Forsiden (countdown, "SMIL!", every cover line).

rules.name: The Faces Zone Rule
rules.body: On a cover, nothing drawn may enter the faces band (y 400 to 1030 on the 1050 x 1400 grid, edge to edge): masthead, strip, teaser and starburst end above it, headline and barcode start below it. The band is where a group of kids stands; the cover lines frame them, never cover them.

rules.name: The Objects-Lift Rule
rules.body: Only pictures, the shutter, the chosen chip and the toast cast shadows. Quiet pills, unselected chips and headings sit flat on the ground.

dos: **Do** keep the picture the largest object on any screen, at its world's ratio (5:7 card, 3:4 cover), with the 0 24px 60px picture-lift shadow.
**Do** draw anything that belongs to the picture on its canvas grid (1000 x 1400 card, 1050 x 1400 cover) so preview, JPEG and print match.
**Do** add a new world as a theme: a registry entry with its own frames, shutter label and surprise, a painter, and a `data-theme` block that re-skins the shared components rather than forking them.
**Do** mark the chosen option in the world's chosen colour with dark text: gold/navy in Samlekort, yellow/ink in Forsiden; keep the shutter colour for the capture pill only.
**Do** pair every control word with an icon from the two authored sets: filled element glyphs or stroked UI icons at 2.2.
**Do** put new controls in pills or chips of at least 72px height, with press-scale feedback.
**Do** stroke display text in the world's dark (navy or ink) whenever it sits on the photo.
**Do** keep cover lines out of the faces zone (y 400 to 1030 on the cover grid).
donts: **Don't** use uppercase or small tracked captions in Samlekort chrome; caps there belong only to card furniture. In Forsiden, caps go on Anton display, never on Baloo labels.
**Don't** add hard offset shadows or coloured glows in either world; depth is soft dark lift, the foil layer or the gloss hotspot.
**Don't** introduce square or slightly rounded rectangles in chrome; chrome is pills and discs in both worlds. Square forms belong to the cover itself and its printed result strap.

**Don't** animate chrome beyond press-scale, the chip pick, the countdown and the result panel's rise-in (0.6s after the reveal); ambient motion belongs to the picture (foil on cards, masthead gloss on covers).
**Don't** let a frame colour carry light ink when the colour is light (see The Declared Ink Rule).
**Don't** mix worlds inside one picture: no foil on covers, no Anton on cards.
